backfill_dataset: backfill a dataset by analyzing its state and creating jobs for all missing processing steps
remove_dataset: remove a dataset by deleting its waiting jobs, cache entries, storage directories, and ref branches
finish_job: finish a job by storing its result in the cache and triggering the next processing steps
set_revision: set the current revision of a dataset and create jobs for every first processing step
smart_set_revision: smart update a dataset revision by only updating cache and storage when only metadata files changed
